findings.invariant: 当前 Story、family、series 的近似非规范 basename 必须归为 malformed-current-intent 并 fail-close。
findings.trigger_condition: Canonical dir contains selected-series main@round delimiter
findings.actual_result: `11-9-code-review-summary-20260905-main@round-1.md` 未命中有限的 `.`, `+`, `:`, `-`, `_` 分隔检测，被返回为 `unrelated`；canonical candidate 随后可返回 `ok:true`。
findings.expected_result: 该 basename 应归为 `malformed-current-intent`，并在任何后续写入前返回 current-series evidence invalid。
findings.guard_snippet: Reject every selected-series known-family basename that is noncanonical before returning unrelated.
findings.potential_consequence: Malformed current evidence is silently bypassed
findings.first_hand_diff_evidence: 新增 classifier 仅在 lines 441-456 枚举部分分隔符，line 458 对其余情况无条件返回 unrelated。

findings.invariant: 决定 artifact identity 或 DONE authority 的 YAML key 必须语义唯一。
findings.trigger_condition: Finalizer uses explicit-key result plus bare result
findings.actual_result: Leading frontmatter 中 `? result` / `: HALTED` 被逐行忽略，后续 `result: DONE` 被接受；在其余 graph 合法时 resolver 可把语义重复的 finalizer 认证为 DONE。
findings.expected_result: 任何 YAML-equivalent duplicate authority key 都应使 frontmatter 无效并阻断 completion recognition。
findings.guard_snippet: Parse the bounded frontmatter with duplicate-key errors enabled before projecting authority fields.
findings.potential_consequence: Ambiguous authority can certify a completed run
findings.first_hand_diff_evidence: 新增 parser 只拒绝 quoted keys、只检测 regex 可见 bare-key duplicates，并忽略 explicit-key 两行结构。

findings.invariant: 用于认证 predecessor 的 inline YAML list 必须是可解析的合法 YAML。
findings.trigger_condition: Review list contains invalid double-quoted escape
findings.actual_result: 例如 `declaredFiles: ["\q"]` 时，parser 对反斜杠后的任意字符直接复制并返回非 null，`validPredecessorSchema` 因而接受 YAML-invalid review evidence。
findings.expected_result: 不属于 YAML double-quoted escape 集合的序列必须使 list 与 predecessor schema 校验失败。
findings.guard_snippet: Validate double-quoted escapes against YAML grammar or use a fail-closed YAML parser.
findings.potential_consequence: Malformed predecessor evidence can certify DONE
findings.first_hand_diff_evidence: 新增 loop lines 789-794 无条件接受任意 escaped character，lines 705-708 只检查返回值非 null。

findings.invariant: resolver 读取的 artifact 与 tracker 必须保持在已验证目录内且不得跟随 symlink。
findings.trigger_condition: Checked file is swapped before separate readFile
findings.actual_result: `lstat` 和 `realpath` 校验结束后，代码按原始 pathname 单独 `readFile`；并发替换为 symlink 可令读取跟随到已验证 parent 外的文件。
findings.expected_result: 应以 no-follow 打开文件，并在同一 descriptor 上 `fstat`、绑定路径与读取内容。
findings.guard_snippet: Open with no-follow and validate then read through the same file descriptor.
findings.first_hand_diff_evidence: 新增 `readBoundRegularFile` lines 665-670 将检查与读取分成三个 pathname-based filesystem operations。
